candidates.summary: ADR Consequences 1-2 are proved only against pickyApp, an app with no store; gno.land's own app may not fail boot on a refused genesis or may not boot the corrected file on the same DB
candidates.failure_scenario: gno.land InitChainer loads stdlibs and stores consensus params before loadAppState refuses an InitialHeight mismatch; a write that outlives the refusal would make the restart on the same DB diverge or fail
candidates.verify_by: go test -run TestJudgeRejectedGenesisRestart -v ./gno.land/pkg/gnoland with tests/judge-r1-rejected-genesis-restart_test.go copied in, at head and at the merge base

candidates.summary: genesisApplied's godoc says height 0 of the ABCI responses is never pruned; a pruner deleting it would reset a committed chain's state record
candidates.failure_scenario: any code deleting abciResponsesKey:0 makes genesisApplied false on a running chain, whose persisted doc has no AppState since gnolang/gno#5684, so resetToGenesisDoc rebuilds its state record
candidates.verify_by: grep -rn 'CalcABCIResponsesKey' tm2 gno.land contribs outside _test.go for a Delete

candidates.summary: the tripwire comment says no current path skips a deliverable tx; a deliverGenesisTx return before the result handler would make the guard fire on a valid genesis
candidates.failure_scenario: a deliverGenesisTx early return other than metadata.Failed leaves processed < expected and fork test reports FAIL on a good genesis
candidates.verify_by: awk over gno.land/pkg/gnoland/app.go deliverGenesisTx for every return before cfg.GenesisTxResultHandler, and both tx loops

candidates.summary: ADR Consequence 5 orders gnolang/gno#1941 before gnolang/gno#5684 and says saveGenesisDoc began dropping AppState in gnolang/gno#5684
candidates.failure_scenario: if gnolang/gno#5684 predates gnolang/gno#1941, a data dir applied between them carries a nil-AppState doc and no height-0 key, and reaches the reset on a committed chain
candidates.verify_by: git merge-base --is-ancestor 3aa0f0b7d 5d0a4d703; git show of each for SaveABCIResponses(…, 0, …) and stripped.AppState = nil

candidates.summary: Handshake's InfoSync, the sibling ABCI call of the same handshake, still checks only the Go error and reads LastBlockHeight from a response whose Error it ignores
candidates.failure_scenario: an app answering Info with ResponseBase.Error and a zero LastBlockHeight on a running chain sends the handshake to InitChain at appBlockHeight 0
candidates.verify_by: an initChainApp-style app whose Info returns Error, run through NewHandshaker(...).Handshake; no in-tree app does so
